scope: Actual Node outputs for five additional authored graph-boundary cases. Historical source identity retained; Python tests do not re-execute Node.

networkGuard.scope: Documented API guard, not OS network isolation; no source JavaScript execution.

decoding.scope: Already decompressed body; one initial UTF-8 BOM consumed. No charset sniffing, newline normalization or invalid-byte replacement. HTTP origin and completeness are caller evidence, not proved by this decoder.

limitations: Two static HTML hypotheses; no source JavaScript, browser, CSS visibility or search-engine reading.
Template fragments and foreign scripts are inventoried separately; no shadow attachment or frame document extraction.
Original bytes, parser text and locations are distinct; text normalization is not repaired or hidden.
Source completeness and actual HTTP/navigation provenance must be established by separate capture evidence.
Inventory only; no JSON-LD selection, graph, vocabulary validation or TSEP verdict.

network_guard.scope: Documented API guard, not OS network isolation; no source JavaScript execution.

limitations: Processing observations only; no Schema.org or search-feature validation, visible facts or TSEP outcome.
All local contexts are supplied evidence, not authenticated authoritative contexts.
Notices retain omitted or transformed information; observed is not a validity or conformance verdict.

base_parameter.scope: Explicit processor input, not an inferred or observed document.baseURI. Retained base/meta elements may require another hypothesis or attributed rendered capture.

No targeted fragment/profile extraction, external script fetching, JavaScript execution or browser behavior.
